svg.title: One agent run recorded as a tree of spans on a time axis
svg.desc: A trace viewer laid out in two columns. The left column is the span tree: an outer span named invoke_agent, and indented one level beneath it, five child spans in time order — chat pass 1, execute_tool get_invoice, chat pass 2, execute_tool search_orders, and chat pass 3 which made no tool call. The right column shows each span as a horizontal bar positioned and sized by when it ran and how long it took. The second tool span is highlighted as the point where a wrong record entered the run. A footer lists the three things a flat log file of the same run would not have.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Left: the tree, where indentation is parentage. Right: the clock, where bar length is duration.

svg.text: A log file of the same run holds six timestamped lines and none of the structure above: no shared run

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: identifier, so the six interleave with every other job's; no parent, so nothing groups them into one run;

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: and no end times, so every duration has to be inferred by subtracting one line from another.
